digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate candidate measurement and validation
propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, clone+strip driver, pure metrics library, golden tests) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not landed on main.

The ~450-run live LLM batch replay for coarse and precise gate candidate evaluation was permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder which accumulates verdict-perturbation signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.
History-based baseline mining is infeasible due to only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines existing versus ~200 required after the impact_model_version bump stranded the historical data.

The recall-stripped clone design (copy store, delete REVIEW_RESULT.json files, run fresh) combined with material-fingerprint drift guards and two-tier fresh evaluation (candidate and current both replayed N=3 with two-level-median pairing) eliminates confounds from prior findings and LLM nondeterminism.

The pure e3_metrics library provides LLM-free methods (build_matrix, criterion_deltas, tkey, pass_to_block_flip_rate, fp_control_eval, fp_control_valid) and is golden-tested offline against synthetic fixtures without live LLM execution.
